reason: the design fails 2 of its checks

findings.text:
FSTG-1: 1 part to fix
FSTG-1[code]: --from-stage <s> rehydrates all stages before <s> and dispatches <s> as the first stage covers: FROM-1 FROM-2
  Given: A previous run completed stages before <s>; their artifacts are present in the git state branch; a new invocation uses --from-stage <s>
  When: The runner starts with --from-stage <s>
  Then: The artifacts from every stage before <s> appear in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the dispatch loop starts
  And: Stage <s> is dispatched as the first stage (a stage.start event is emitted for <s>) [FIX IN DESIGN: the design fixture sets <s>=cyc, a cycle stage dispatched through the cycle:* arm (runner.sh:3482), which calls cycle_orchestrator_run; that function emits cycle.start (cycle-orchestrator.sh:2363), never stage.start for the cycle ID; stage.start is only emitted for leaf stages via the stage:* arm (runner.sh:3820) or for cycle members inside _cycle_dispatch (runner.sh:3213–3215); the test compensates by asserting stage.start for cycled (the inner member of cyc, a different stage ID), not for <s>=cyc itself, so the And's literal requirement is never satisfied by any code path — it cannot be true together with that; make them agree]
  And: No stage.start event is emitted for any stage before <s>

DSPK-1: 1 part to fix
DSPK-1[code]: On resume, stage k (the interrupted stage) is dispatched and emits stage.start covers: RESU-3 RESU-4
  Given: A run with stages 1…N was interrupted during stage k; stages 1…k-1 are marked complete with their artifacts present in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after rehydration
  When: The dispatch loop reaches stage k during resume
  Then: Stage k emits a stage.start event [FIX IN DESIGN: the fixture used by the DSPK-1 assertion (s1 state, same as RHYD-1 path 1) sets k=cyc, a cycle stage; the cycle:* dispatch arm (runner.sh:3482) calls cycle_orchestrator_run, which emits cycle.start (cycle-orchestrator.sh:2363) for the cycle ID, not stage.start; the test asserts stage.start for cycled (the inner member, stage ID ≠ k), not for k=cyc itself; so "Stage k emits a stage.start event" is never true when k is a cycle stage dispatched through the cycle:* arm — it cannot be true together with that; make them agree]
